name: SetupGuide
need: First-run is an archetype with only half a carrier: AdaptiveListPage handles the empty welcome, but the 'get set up' checklist — the thing that turns a first run into a working install — is rebuilt per product (airun's Readiness under the login, SetupNeeded on the cockpit; JuAI and VP-easy outside the monorepo). Shopify's setup guide is the proven shape: steps with state, a counted progress line, and a dismissal that never returns.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: A stepper is a linear flow the user walks through now; setup steps are done in any order, over days, each with its own control.
That is airun's SetupNeeded — right for what STOPS work, wrong for guiding a first run: three alerts stacked read as three failures, not one path.

proposedApi.SetupGuide: title, steps [{id, label, detail, done, action}], onDismiss + dismissLabel — the dismiss renders only when every step is done, and a dismissed guide never returns (the caller persists it): first-run and steady-state are ONE page with a section that retires itself

sources: Shopify app-home setup guide (checklist card, counted progress, dismissed-forever), airun SetupNeeded (the render-nothing-when-healthy contract the notices slot inherits)
decision: Build as an organism per the golden-screens G6 batch; pairs with OverviewPageTemplate's notices slot and AdaptiveListPage's welcome for the full onboarding story.
